narrative_purpose: Open the chapter on the gesture that contains the whole discipline: a navigator reading the column of air straight above her, not the horizon, and choosing a layer from it.
subject: A tall slender blue-skinned humanoid figure with a long braid, standing at the woven rail of a small gondola, seen from behind and slightly to the side. Her head is tilted fully back to look straight up. One arm is raised above her head with the palm held flat and horizontal. She wears close-fitting layered dark cloth wrappings covered in fine swirling woven patterns, dressed for cold.
scene: The gondola is a woven basket of pale fibre and lashed timber, slung on rigging lines beneath the curved underside of a vast pale gasbag that fills the top corner of the frame. Beyond the rail, open air. Far below the gondola a flat deck of dark cloud. Above and beyond, a second higher cloud deck. Highest of all, thin parallel streaks of cloud drawn out across the pale dawn sky.
camera: Medium shot from just behind the figure's shoulder, angled upward so the viewer's eye follows her gaze up past the two cloud decks to the streaks above.
light: Cold pale dawn light from low on the horizon, catching the edge of her raised palm and the rail. The gasbag above is in shadow. Faint cyan glow from small bioluminescent fibres woven into the rigging.
palette: Cool indigo and grey-blue dominate; pale mist tones in the dawn sky; the figure's skin a deep muted blue; one restrained cyan accent in the rigging glow.
style: Painterly naturalist figure study, intimate and quiet, cold morning air made visible.
detail_level: Crisp on the figure, her raised hand and the gondola rail; the cloud decks and streaks soften into haze with distance.
composition: The figure occupies the lower left third, facing up and away. A large area of open dawn sky in the upper right, plain and uncluttered, holds the layered cloud decks. Keep that sky region simple and low-detail so overlaid callouts read cleanly.
consistency_notes: She carries NO instruments of any kind — no compass, no chart, no device. That absence is the point of the chapter. The gesture is calm and deliberate, not dramatic. Cool dawn palette with sparse cyan bioluminescence.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no compass, no charts, no instruments, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
